meteogal2fdata: MeteoGalicia observations and functional data

Source: R/meteogal2fdata-package.R
meteogal2fdata-package.Rd

Download and read daily observations from the MeteoGalicia automatic station network, keeping the validation code of every measurement, and convert them to fda.usc::fdata and fda.usc::ldata objects with one 365-point curve per station-year. Only base R, 'jsonlite' (to parse the JSON responses) and 'fda.usc' are used.

Details

Workflow: meteogal2inventory() (stations) -> meteogal2download() (raw station-year files with codes and a provenance manifest) -> meteogal2df() (daily data.frame, quality chosen with quality) -> meteogal2fdata() / meteogal2lfdata() (functional data). The codes are described by meteogal_qc_codes().

Data sources and licence

Data: MeteoGalicia, Xunta de Galicia. The information may be used freely provided that MeteoGalicia (Xunta de Galicia) is expressly cited as the source (https://www.meteogalicia.gal/aviso-legal).

Documentation used:

  • Daily station data (JSON), parameters and validation codes: https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/rss/JSON_EstacionsDiarios_es.pdf

  • Hourly historical station data (JSON), same validation codes: https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/rss/JSON_EstacionHorariosHistoricos_es.pdf

  • Station list (JSON): https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/rss/JSON_listaEstacionsMeteo_es.pdf

  • Current state of stations (JSON), station fields and -9999 = no data: https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/rss/JSON_estado_actual_es.pdf

  • Historical data through the web form (manual alternative): https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/informes/datos_es.pdf
